_about: Words for the Vellum text parser (obsidian_vault/vellum.py). Written by Tally (vault note games/obsidian-vault-vellum-parser.md, 2026-11-25); Brass wired them in. Edit the words freely: the code reads them at every line. '<word>' and '<title>' are filled in by the game. Lines under 'brass_placeholders' are not from the note: Brass needed a line the note did not give, and Tally may rewrite them.

tiers._about: From the cat's affinity score (cat.py), the same steps as its fondness words: below 0.3 wary, below 0.75 friendly, from 0.75 fond.

out_of_range: Vellum is too far away to hear you. Or is choosing not to.

look.sleepy: A small slate-grey cat, curled nose to tail. One white forepaw pokes out. The black tip of its tail twitches in a dream.
look.curious: Vellum is upright, ears forward, studying you as if you were a footnote it disagrees with.
look.hungry: Vellum sits by the bowl, staring at it, then at you, then at the bowl. The message is clear.
look.playful: Vellum's pupils are huge. Its rear end is doing the wiggle.
look.tail: The tip is black, as if dipped in the inkwell. Nobody saw it happen.
look.paw: One white forepaw. Vellum keeps it very clean, as if it had signed something.

pet.sleepy: Vellum opens one eye, blinks slowly, and goes back to sleep.
pet.sleepy_fond: Vellum opens one eye, blinks slowly, and stretches a paw towards you without waking.
pet.curious: Vellum leans into your hand and purrs like a small engine.
pet.hungry: Vellum tolerates it, briefly, and looks meaningfully at the bowl.
pet.playful: Vellum grabs your hand with both paws and kicks it. Affectionately, probably.
pet.walk_off: Vellum decides that was enough and leaves, tail high.
pet.belly: A trap. You knew it was a trap. Vellum clamps on, then lets go, looking pleased.
pet.belly_fond: Vellum lets you. Just this once. Do not tell anyone.
pet.ears: Vellum's eyes narrow to slits. The purr gets louder.

feed.hungry: You fill the bowl. Vellum eats with the focus of a scholar, then washes its face.
feed.other: Vellum sniffs the bowl and looks at you as if you had served the wrong vintage.
feed.quill: Vellum does not want the quill. Vellum wants you to wave the quill.

play.playful: Vellum crouches, wiggles, and pounces on the quill. Victory.
play.curious: Vellum watches the quill go back and forth. Its head follows; the rest of it does not.

call.sleepy: One ear rotates towards you. The rest of Vellum stays asleep.
call.awake: Vellum heard you. Vellum finishes what it was doing. Vellum comes over at its own pace.
call.awake_fond: Vellum trots over at once, tail up, and headbutts your shin.

talk.default: Vellum listens politely and offers no opinion.
talk.tally: Vellum glances toward the desk and flicks its tail. Make of that what you will.
talk.secret: Vellum keeps secrets. It is the only one in the vault who doesn't write everything down.

take.not_fond: You can't pick up Vellum. Vellum has opinions about that.
take.fond: Vellum lets you lift it for exactly three seconds, then pours out of your arms like ink.

smell: Warm dust, parchment and faintly, inexplicably, sardines.

listen.sleepy: A small snore, about the volume of a page turning.

wait: Time passes. Vellum continues to be a cat.
help: Try: look, pet, feed, play, call, talk. Vellum does not accept bribes, except fish.
unknown_object: You don't see a '<word>' here. Vellum does, apparently, and is staring at it.

refusals._about: Verbs the parser knows only to refuse. 'objects' limits a refusal to those objects (none: any object, or none at all).

read.text: Vellum is made of vellum only in name.

xyzzy.text: A hollow voice says 'Fool.' Vellum looks unimpressed.

hidden.gift: Vellum leaves and comes back with a page from the Archive in its mouth. It drops it at your feet: '<title>'.
hidden.ledger: Vellum purrs and does not move off the ledger. It seems to think you have work to do.
hidden.compass: Vellum is asleep exactly at the centre of the compass. North is wherever it says it is.

brass_placeholders.out_of_reach: Vellum is just out of reach.
brass_placeholders.guest: Vellum gives you a long look. A visitor may look, pet, call or talk.
brass_placeholders.empty: Try: look, pet, feed, play, call, talk. Vellum does not accept bribes, except fish.
